ZZ DEMO Rimal Decoration LLC
Company profile 2026 - Decoration - Outdoor living - Pools
About Rimal
Since 2012 Rimal has been a decoration company for villas, majlis, apartments and boutique
offices in Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman. From the front gate to the last cushion, our clients give us
the whole home.
Inside the home
Complete interior decoration of villas and apartments, from concept and 3D design to
handover
Gypsum ceilings, cornices and feature walls
Wall painting, stucco and decorative paint finishes
Wallpaper and decorative wall panels
Parquet and SPC flooring
Curtains, blinds and upholstery of majlis seating
Custom wardrobes and TV units made in our own carpentry workshop in Al Quoz
Outside the home
Our gardens team turns the plot around the villa into a place to live in.
Garden design and landscaping: planting, lawns and palm trees
Interlock paving, garden paths and boundary walls
Automatic irrigation systems
Pergolas, gazebos and outdoor seating areas
Garden lighting
Monthly garden maintenance contracts
Swimming pools
Swimming pools, jacuzzis and water features are designed and built through our specialist
partner, ZZ DEMO Blue Lagoon Pools, under our supervision and under one contract with you.
Pool maintenance is also arranged through them.
Recent work
Full decoration of a 6-bedroom villa, Al Barsha South (2025)
Garden, pergola and pool for a villa in Mirdif (2025)
Majlis and dining room, Al Khawaneej (2024)
Boutique office interior, 320 m2, Business Bay (2024)
How we work
One designer and one site supervisor stay with the project from the first visit to the handover.
We give a fixed price after the site visit.

Company profile 2026 - Crafting spaces. Building trust.
Crafting spaces. Building trust.
Chairman's message
Two decades ago we began with a small team and a simple belief: that every space tells a
story. Today that belief still guides every decision we take. I thank our clients, our partners and
above all our people for their trust. Together we look to the future with confidence and
ambition.
Our story
ZZ DEMO Meridian Interiors LLC was founded in Dubai in 2004. From a team of twelve we have
grown to more than 400 people, a 2,400 m2 joinery factory in Dubai Investments Park and a
portfolio of more than 600 completed projects across the Emirates.
Vision, mission, values
Vision: to be the most trusted name in the region for spaces that inspire. Mission: to deliver on
time, on budget and beyond expectation. Values: integrity, craftsmanship, safety, respect,
innovation.
Health, safety and environment
The safety of our people comes first. We work to an integrated management system, hold
toolbox talks every morning and have recorded two million man-hours without a lost-time
incident.
Quality policy
We are committed to continual improvement. Our management system is certified to ISO
Our people
Board of directors. Managing director. Projects director. Commercial manager. Design manager.
Factory manager. HSE manager. 14 project managers, 22 site engineers, 31 foremen, 280
craftsmen.
Our factory
CNC routers, edge banders, a spray booth and a polishing line. Capacity: 180 doors or 60
wardrobes a week.
Our clients
Hotel operators, retail brands, banks, law firms, developers, clinics and private villa owners.
Selected projects

feature ceiling, kitchen wall cladding.

panelling, reception counter, boardroom table.

wallcovering, carpets.
Private villa, Emirates Hills
2024. Interior works to a 7-bedroom villa: walk-in wardrobes, kitchen, wood panelling, marble staircase,
decorative painting.

Bank branch roll-out, 6 branches
2024. Fit-out and rebranding of six branches in Dubai and Sharjah: teller counters, partitions, ceilings,
flooring, signage installation.
Specialty coffee chain, 11 outlets
2023-2025. Design and build of cafe interiors: counters, banquettes, wall cladding, lighting, MEP
modifications.
Co-working space, Dubai Design District
2023. Office fit-out, 3,000 m2: phone booths, joinery lockers, raised flooring, glazed meeting rooms.
Show apartments for a developer, Dubai Hills
2023. Three show apartments, fully fitted and furnished in 30 days: kitchens, wardrobes, loose furniture,
curtains.
Fine-dining restaurant, Downtown Dubai
2023. Turnkey fit-out: timber ceiling, brass screens, marble bar, banquette upholstery.
Jewellery boutique, Gold Souk Extension
2023. Retail fit-out: showcases, safes room joinery, feature ceiling, stone flooring.
Corporate office, Abu Dhabi Global Market
2022. Office fit-out, 1,400 m2: partitions, ceilings, carpets, joinery, AV-ready boardrooms.
Paediatric clinic, Al Wasl Road
2022. Clinic fit-out: curved joinery reception, vinyl flooring, wall protection, themed ceilings.
Hotel lobby and all-day dining, Deira
2022. Refurbishment during operation: marble flooring, timber wall panelling, feature lighting, buffet
counters.
Penthouse, Palm Jumeirah
2022. Interior works: kitchen, wardrobes, wooden doors, parquet flooring, home cinema joinery.
University library, Sharjah
2021. Joinery package: 1,200 linear metres of shelving, study carrels, reading tables, acoustic wall
panels.
Perfume retail chain, 9 kiosks
2021. Design, manufacture and installation of mall kiosks.
Awards
Commercial Interior Design Awards: Fit-out Firm of the Year, shortlisted 2023 and 2024. Best
Restaurant Interior, 2025.
Sustainability and community
FSC-certified timber on request. Low-VOC lacquers. We sponsor a vocational carpentry course
and an annual beach clean-up.

About Gulf Horizon
ZZ DEMO Gulf Horizon Technical Supplies LLC has supplied contractors, shipyards, factories
and oil and gas service companies from its Jebel Ali warehouse since 2004.
Our principals
We are the authorised UAE distributor for:
ZZ Kronwerk (Germany): cordless and corded power tools, rotary hammers, angle
grinders
ZZ Tessaro (Italy): centrifugal and submersible pumps, booster sets
ZZ Northgard (Sweden): safety helmets, harnesses, lanyards and fall-arrest systems
ZZ Hanbit (Korea): welding machines, electrodes and MIG wire
Brands we stock
Makita, Bosch, DeWalt, Stanley, Hilti, Fischer, 3M, Honeywell, Karcher, Loctite, WD-40, Norton,
Yale, Kito.
Services
Tool repair and warranty service centre in Jebel Ali
